what: On first open, three panels covering the screen (from the bottom: accent color, pale gray, white) lift away starting with the top one at .2s intervals. Each panel’s bottom edge center rises to 76% of the screen in .5s (power3.in), then folds up to the top edge in .6, .6 and .8s (power3.out). The first starts after .35s. One second before the last panel finishes folding, the center logo fades over 1 second (expo.out). Then fx:reveal fires .9s later (when the hero photo settles) and fx:done at 2.05s

options.delay: Time before the first section starts (s), default .35
options.up: Duration of the center lift (sec), default .5
options.fold: Fold length per section (seconds, from the top section, comma-separated), default .6,.6,.8
options.reveal: Time from when the logo starts to blur until fx:reveal (seconds), default .9
options.--fx-sheet-1 · 2 · 3: Bottom · middle · top section colors — default accent · light accent · surface color
options.[data-fx-part=sheet]: One curtain — a single path inside an svg with viewBox 0 0 1000 1000 and preserveAspectRatio none (in document order from the section below)
options.[data-fx-part=logo]: Center logo (optional) — don’t place the svg directly, wrap it in a span (otherwise the svg order in the mask shifts)

use: Logo
note: To show it only once per session, the consuming side removes the element before attaching it (the original runs only on barba once — it does not appear when navigating within the site). With reduced motion, the curtain is hidden
